# Gettin

g Started

> Start testing your MCP server in minutes

> [!NOTE]
>
> The upcoming SDK 10, CLI 6, and Vitest 0.3 releases req
uire an MCPJam login or `sk_` API key for every eval, including BYOK runs with uploads disabled. These versions must ship after th

e backend run-start endpoint is deployed. Earlier versions keep their existing behavior.

## 1. Choose how to open Inspector
Every option below opens the MCPJam Inspector. Pick one based on where your MCP server runs.\n\n> [card] [Web](https://app.mcpjam.

com)
>
> No install. HTTPS servers only. Share servers with your team.

> [card] [Terminal](https://docs.mcpjam.com/installati

on.md#terminal)
>
> `npx @mcpjam/inspector@latest`. Requires Node.js. HTTP/S and local STDIO.

> [card] [macOS](https://docs.m

cpjam.com/installation.md#desktop-app)
>
> Desktop app (`.dmg`). No Node.js. HTTP/S and local STDIO.

> [card] [Windows](https

://docs.mcpjam.com/installation.md#desktop-app)
>
> Desktop app (`.exe` installer). No Node.js. HTTP/S and local STDIO.

> [ca
rd] [Docker](https://docs.mcpjam.com/installation.md#docker)\n>\n> Pull from Docker Hub. HTTP/S, plus STDIO servers that run insid

e the container.

* **Your server has a public HTTPS URL**: any option works. The web app needs no install.
* **Your server run
s on `localhost` or over STDIO**: use Terminal or the macOS or Windows desktop app. The web app can't reach it.\n* **You want Insp
ector isolated in a container**: use Docker. Reach servers on your machine at `http://host.docker.internal:PORT`, and note that ST
DIO commands run inside the container, not on your machine.\n\nSee [Installation](https://docs.mcpjam.com/installation.md#which-on

e-do-i-need) for the full comparison.
